body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/rails.test.mjs` contains 28 `try/finally` blocks and a local `runRails` helper that creates scratch directories with `mkdtempSync` and clears them in `finally`. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit`, this test file can adopt `tmp(t)` with automatic `t.after` cleanup.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/rails.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update `runRails(ticketsJson, relPath, options = {}, t = null)`: if `t` is passed and `!options.keepDir`, allocate the directory via `tmp(t, 'adlc-rails-')` and eliminate the manual `rmSync(dir)` in `finally`.
   - Update test cases to accept `t` and pass `t` to `runRails`.
   - Remove the redundant `try/finally` blocks around `runRails` invocations.
2. Verify all tests pass: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/rails.test.mjs`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/rails.test.mjs` reports 0 (down from 28).
- AC2 All assertions and tests in `rails.test.mjs` remain functionally identical.
- AC3 `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/rails.test.mjs` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC4 `npm test -w plugins/adlc-claude-code` exits 0.
- AC5 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(adlc-claude-code): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 28 try/finally blocks in rails.test.mjs
